test.name: Fuzz runtime_archive for 10 minutes on the spec 0018 extractor

expected: cargo xtask fuzz run runtime_archive --time 600 runs for 600 seconds from the committed seeds and finds no crash, hang, or out of memory.
actual: no crash, hang, or out of memory and fuzz/artifacts/runtime_archive is empty; 882320 runs in 601 s (1468 exec/s), cov 3312, ft 10703, corpus 971 inputs (1666 Kb), peak RSS 505 MB; 1898 new units added
steps: use the pinned fuzz toolchain nightly-2026-10-17 and cargo-fuzz 0.13.2 on commit 27e4135 (spec 0018 step 16 landed, fuzz code unchanged since milestone 1)
`cargo xtask fuzz seed` first: no seed file changed (54 runtime_archive seeds, 9 runtime_macho seeds)
run the two targets one after the other, `cargo xtask fuzz run <target> --time 600`, starting from the committed seeds and an empty fuzz/corpus, with -max_len 1048576 as xtask sets it
check that each command exits 0 with `ran for 600 s without a crash`, that fuzz/artifacts/<target>/ is empty, and read the libFuzzer final stats
both runs shared the Mac with other sessions building and testing, so exec/s is a floor; the logs live in the session scratchpad and are not kept here; fuzz/target was deleted afterwards
